in_marathi.name: Dyuthika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Radiant, Shining One
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dyuthika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dyuthika is a Sanskrit name for a radiant, shining one. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'dyuti', meaning 'light' or 'shining'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity.
